Mechanism incompletely understood; modulates inositol signaling, GSK-3β, neuroprotection

name: Phenylephrine
effects: Selective alpha-1 adrenergic agonist — nasal decongestant
Raises blood pressure; less CNS stimulation than pseudoephedrine
FDA advisory committee in 2023 found oral phenylephrine ineffective as decongestant
Minimal CNS penetration; essentially no psychostimulant effect orally
